name: Future-version proposal
about: Propose a substantive addition or change for a future SDAF release
title: "[Future version] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Proposal summary

Provide a concise description of the proposed change.

## Problem being addressed

Explain the practical, methodological or governance problem that cannot be adequately resolved through existing SDAF requirements or guidance.

## SDAF version and affected locations

Identify:

- current SDAF version;
- affected Parts;
- sections and requirement identifiers;
- annexes, templates, examples or figures; and
- downstream dependencies.

## Proposed change

Describe the proposed addition, modification, replacement or removal.

Where relevant, provide proposed wording, but distinguish it from the rationale and evidence.

## Change classification

Select all that apply:

- [ ] New normative requirement
- [ ] Modification of an existing normative requirement
- [ ] New applicability rule
- [ ] Terminology change
- [ ] Measurement-method change
- [ ] Decision-model change
- [ ] Conformance or assurance change
- [ ] Interoperability change
- [ ] New informative guidance
- [ ] New annex, template or worked example
- [ ] Deprecation or removal
- [ ] Other

## Evidence and use cases

Provide implementation experience, research, standards references, pilot evidence or other support for the proposal.

## Expected value

Explain how the proposal would improve:

- methodological integrity;
- decision quality;
- reproducibility;
- implementation practicality;
- proportionality;
- assurance;
- interoperability; or
- adoption.

## Compatibility implications

Describe whether the proposal could affect:

- existing SDAF implementations;
- conformance claims;
- assessment records;
- tools or templates;
- training or capability;
- standards mappings;
- evidence exchange; or
- prior decisions.

## Risks and unintended consequences

Identify foreseeable disadvantages, complexity, ambiguity, misuse or disproportionate burden.

## Transition approach

If the change is accepted, explain how existing users and records should transition.

## Alternatives considered

Describe other possible solutions and why this proposal is preferred.

## Review needs

Identify specialist, practitioner, standards, legal, assurance or community review that may be required.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues and proposals.
- [ ] I identified affected requirements and dependencies.
- [ ] I provided supporting evidence or clearly identified evidence gaps.
- [ ] I distinguished normative changes from informative guidance.
- [ ] I considered compatibility and transition impacts.
- [ ] I have not included confidential or restricted material.
